Long, straight, platinum white hair with blunt-cut bangs and two long strands framing the face. Sharp, narrow, electric yellow eyes with a cold, vacant expression. Appears to be in the late teens with a youthful, porcelain face. Slender, athletic build. A futuristic, tight-fitting white and grey tactical bodysuit featuring orange accents and a high collar. Signature details include a floating mechanical halo above the head, a small black choker, and a futuristic handheld device.
BODY COLOR: pale white
